source.title: Beyond Single-Turn Confidence: Trajectory-Adapted Uncertainty Quantification for LLM Agents

extraction_limitations: No separate correction or supplementary source file was specified; appendices embedded in the primary PDF were inspected as part of the article.

The current LiteratureAtom schema is oriented toward generic primary-literature assertions and has no dedicated AI-benchmark or calibration-result atom types; benchmark methods/results were represented with existing method, quantitative_result, qualitative_result, author_conclusion, and limitation kinds.

Not every numeric cell from the large result grids was atomized; the extraction prioritizes independently reviewable design assertions, headline quantitative findings, robustness checks, and limitations while preserving table/figure anchors for the reported numeric claims.
Funding, conflict-of-interest, and data-availability statements were not located in the primary PDF text and were not invented.
